# National Geographic

> > National Geographic's comprehensive platform for science, environment, travel, history, and wildlife exploration, featuring content from NASA missions, climate research, and global destinations.

National Geographic offers authoritative journalism and educational resources across multiple domains including space exploration (Apollo 11, NASA's DART mission), environmental issues (climate change, Alaska glaciers), wildlife conservation (Africa's elephants, axolotls), and cultural heritage. The platform includes dedicated sections for kids' education, travel guides, and magazine features.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change & Environmental Issues
- Space Exploration (NASA, Apollo 11, DART Mission)
- Wildlife Conservation & Biodiversity
- Travel & UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Science & Health Research
- Ancient Civilizations & Archaeology
- Geography & Culture
- National Geographic Kids Education
- Photography & Visual Storytelling
- Sustainable Travel & Ecotourism
- Ocean & Marine Life
- Intermittent Fasting & Nutrition
- Microbes & Decomposition Science
- Africa & Global Destinations
- History & Cultural Heritage

## Core Content Sections

- [National Geographic Homepage](https://nationalgeographic.com): Homepage featuring NASA's DART mission & latest exploration stories
- [Science](https://nationalgeographic.com/science): Main science section covering health, climate, biodiversity & discoveries
- [Environment](https://nationalgeographic.com/environment): Environment section on Alaska glaciers, climate change & melting ice
- [Travel](https://nationalgeographic.com/travel): Travel section featuring UNESCO sites, destinations & climate impacts
- [History & Culture](https://nationalgeographic.com/history): History section on Apollo 11 moon landing & archaeological discoveries
- [National Geographic Magazine](https://nationalgeographic.com/magazine): Magazine section with stories on Africa's elephants & wildlife exploration
- [Health](https://nationalgeographic.com/health): Health section featuring intermittent fasting, nutrition & wellness topics

## Latest Stories & Features

- [Latest Stories](https://nationalgeographic.com/pages/topic/latest-stories): News feed with latest articles including Apollo 11 & space history
- [Phenomena Science Blog](https://phenomena.nationalgeographic.com): Science blog featuring articles on microbes, bacteria, and decomposition
- [Brazil Travel Guide](https://nationalgeographic.com/travel/article/brazil-essential-travel-guide): Brazil travel guide featuring Rio, Pantanal wildlife & Carnival culture

## Educational Resources & Reference

- [Planet Earth Facts](https://nationalgeographic.com/science/article/earth): Reference article on Earth's structure, orbit & solar system role
- [United States Geography for Kids](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/geography/countries/article/united-states): Educational profile on United States geography, regions & states for kids
- [Egypt Country Profile](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/geography/countries/article/egypt): Egypt country profile covering Nile River, pyramids & ancient civilization
- [Axolotl Facts for Kids](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/animals/amphibians/facts/axolotl): Facts on endangered axolotl salamanders in Mexico City's Xochimilco
- [Afghanistan Country Profile](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/geography/countries/article/afghanistan): Afghanistan profile on Central Asia geography, ethnic groups & culture
- [Explorer Academy Guides](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/explorer-academy/article/get-guides): Educational guides for Explorer Academy book series with teaching resources

## Guides & How-To Resources

- [How to Compost](https://nationalgeographic.com/environment/article/how-to-compost): Tutorial on home composting, food waste reduction & methane emissions
- [Travel Tips](https://nationalgeographic.com/travel/topic/travel-tips): Essential travel tips on visas, low-lying islands & sustainable travel
- [Make an Underwater Scope](https://kids.nationalgeographic.com/books/article/underwater-scope): DIY craft instructions for building an underwater scope for kids

## Support & Customer Service

- [Support Center](https://helpcenter.nationalgeographic.com): Customer support center for National Geographic Partners services
- [Contact Support](https://helpcenter.nationalgeographic.com/s/contactsupport): Contact customer support form for National Geographic Partners
- [History Magazine Customer Service](https://helpcenter.nationalgeographic.com/s/article/NAT-GEO-HISTORY-Magazine-Customer-Service): Customer service info for National Geographic History Magazine subscriptions
